title: Neighbours' safety fears put 100-acre Kansas deer-hunting business under zoning rules
summary_full: A Kansas appeals court has ruled that a 100-acre deer-hunting business run by a couple cannot be treated as an agricultural operation and must obtain a special-use zoning permit. The ruling followed objections from two neighbouring couples, who raised safety concerns about commercial hunting taking place close to their properties.
